rules.description: A detector that grades what it saw (a form's sensitivity, a replay tool on a payment page) reports a severity; the finding takes the higher of the type's base and what was observed.
A consent finding naming three or more hosts is one level more serious: the problem is the site's setup, not one tag.
Collection, consent and observation findings on a site in health or education (NACE 86, 85) are one level more serious.
A finding that was closed and is back is one level more serious: the fix did not hold.
